result: No mathematical or placement-oracle blocker found in the six controls; native execution remains root's responsibility

boundary.method: Offline source arithmetic/semantics review plus read-only JSON and log-hash checks of root-produced native witnesses

mathematical_checks: A radius2mm through-Z cylinder of height30mm removes120*pi mm3; the bored result is6000-120*pi mm3.
The disconnected5x5x5 second solid adds125mm3 to the6000mm3 first solid, yielding6125mm3. Point(22,2,2) lies inside it; point(15,10,15) lies in the gap.
Positive90degree Z rotation and translation(100,-20,7) map the original box to world bounds(80,-20,7)-(100,-10,37). The bore center maps to(90,-15,22), and the solid point(1,1,15) maps to(99,-19,22).

All classification sample points are far from intended boundaries relative to the explicit1e-7mm point-classification tolerance. The numerical assertions are software-geometry controls, not project engineering tolerances.
behavioral_checks: The health helper requires actual non-null validity, declared solid count, each solid closed and finite positive volume. It correctly avoids requiring the top-level compound to report global closedness.
Material comparison runs both directed cuts. A non-null invalid difference fails rather than being silently interpreted as empty; each result must have zero vertices.

The successful-cleanup control expects the deliberately unrefined adjoining-box fusion to have more than six faces and its cleaned rectangular prism to have six. This is a fixture precondition to verify in the native run; a different fuse representation would be a control/setup failure, not evidence that the h88 guard failed.

The Base is assigned only in a fresh Part fixture. The test never assigns Structure.Shape. Base, empty Additions/Subtractions and a separate Material link are checked through the public object interface.

The saved-bore method saves and reopens in the same test process, then touches/recomputes and verifies Base and Material links and material geometry. It must not be labeled a separate-process cold test; root's independent checkpoint cold process supplies that distinct evidence.
TestArchBase.tearDown closes the current self.document, so replacing that member with the reopened document is compatible with the existing fixture lifecycle.

coverage_classification.meaning: These ordinary valid primitive cases appear capable of passing the old applyShape implementation. They protect supported geometry/cleanup/placement/persistence behavior, but they are not themselves the RED regression for a valid Base whose native refinement returns invalid. Do not claim that this six-method suite alone reproduces and locks down the reported failure.
coverage_classification.target_regression_evidence: The actual exact-checkpoint and reduced public imported-Base RED-to-GREEN witnesses are the separate failure-sensitive proof. A portable native failure-inducing fixture would be needed for a self-contained CI regression of that fallback path; do not silently publish house-derived geometry or mock an internal collaborator merely to imply such coverage.

observed_witness_meaning: All four inspected executions report passed=true, returncode0, no timeout, reaped child and gone process group; their exact run.log hashes match their execution records.

All four observations record actual build/release/Mod/BIM module origins and ArchComponent SHA62bbd91946639b2b3c473d6d07d53159bf122958f4a425c0c17ba5dad07ca962, not an installed module selected accidentally by an appended import path.
The reduced imported Base and wrapper both record valid/closed/one-positive-solid,1292faces and49054303.568511024mm3; both valid directed material differences have zero vertices.

The exact original checkpoint and save/reopen records preserve their captured controls, including Base/Tool/Shapes and tool links, Refine controls and material link. Their wrapper material is valid and matches the Base under both directed cuts.

The restored wrapper is already valid before its new touch/recompute and remains so afterward. MustExecute/Touched remains true in the recorded objects, which is not to be relabeled as a fix of separate diagnostic beadFreeCAD-muw.
limits: No claim of universal geometric equivalence for all possible valid refinement candidates
No native execution by this reviewer or qualification of pending new-control test runs
